description:
Compact, token-efficient repo maps for coding agents.

When a coding AI (Claude Code, OpenCode, Zed, ...) opens a project, its most expensive activity is not running tools — it's reading code to build a mental model of the repo. vrepo answers that with one deterministic artifact: a small brief holding the module identity, entry points, a file tree with LOC, and per-file symbol outlines — all capped at a character budget you control. Point an agent at the brief instead of at the file system and it starts with a map instead of a maze.

Written in V. Pure V (no subprocesses, no dependencies), same philosophy as v-mcp-server. MIT.
name: gil-silva.vrepo
